title: JSON-LD explained for personal websites
summary: A comprehensive guide explaining JSON-LD (JSON for Linked Data) implementation for personal websites, demonstrating how to add structured data markup to improve SEO and help search engines better understand website content.
problem_solved: Helps personal website owners understand and implement JSON-LD structured data to enhance search engine visibility and content discoverability.
why_valuable: Makes a technical SEO concept accessible for non-technical personal website owners, with practical examples showing how to implement structured data markup.
